# Release security audit and full-repo ponytail-audit

Use the release type requested by the maintainer. A tag ending in `-rc.N` identifies a release candidate. Ask whether the release is stable or a candidate when the request leaves that choice open.

Before creating or pushing a stable or release candidate tag, run the tracked `.claude/skills/security-audit/` skill and the full-repository `ponytail-audit` on the commit to be released. Both audits may also be requested explicitly. Show all findings, resolve blocking security findings and fix every Ponytail Must and Should. Repeat the audits on the final commit if fixes changed it.
In Codex and Claude chat, read each completed report and record it against its full commit SHA as described in `SETUP.md`. The shared chat hook checks for both reports before the tag operation. Commands issued directly in a terminal follow the maintainer checklist.
